value.rationale: The first 2026 treatment leaves the critical model at e^{Theta(n)} and predicts the exponential rate log(1+c) via independence. The theorem derives the precise rate I(c), proves strict I(c)>log(1+c) for every c>0, and gives a full exact stationary inclusion law, a substantive structural correction with plausible follow-on uses for metastable rare-state analysis.
